description: Merge a branch this token created back into the token's base branch (the implicit, only-allowed target). Requires a create-own token with the developer role or higher. The merge does NOT delete the source branch. Call delete_branch afterwards to clean it up. Strategies: overwrite (default; a non-destructive union where the source wins conflicts and keys only on the base are kept), keep-newer (whichever side changed more recently wins), manual (you supply per-conflict resolutions obtained from get_merge_conflicts), branch-changes (only labels created or changed on the branch since it was created are applied, the source winning for those; everything else on the base stays as it is and deletions are not carried over; the result's overlappingKeys lists merged keys the base also changed meanwhile – show them to the user to recheck), and replace (DESTRUCTIVE: the base becomes an exact copy of the source; use only when the user explicitly asks to replace). Merging into main needs an ADMIN-role token; any other token fails with admin_token_required_for_main, and then the user merges in the web app instead. The QA merge gate can refuse the merge with qa_gate_blocked: call run_qa and check_merge_gate first and fix the errors (tokens cannot override the gate). Only merge after the user has reviewed and approved the changes.

branch.description: The branch to merge into the base (must be one this token created).

conflicts.description: Per-conflict resolutions; only consulted with strategy "manual" (get them from get_merge_conflicts).

customValue.description: The value to use when resolution is "custom".

resolution.description: Take the source (branch) value, the target (base) value, or a "custom" value.

strategy.description: Merge strategy (default overwrite). branch-changes applies only what changed on the branch. Use replace only when explicitly told; it is destructive.

name: merge_branch
title: Merge Branch Into Base
